emi.atouchofwickedness.info.wickedness: Killing harmless creatures, or beating up the defenceless, makes you wicked. Pets and babies count for more, and a mob that went for you first counts for nothing. You never see how wicked you are. It wears off slowly, and good deeds take it down faster. Villagers who see a kill will talk about you.
emi.atouchofwickedness.info.standing: Where you stand: Clean, Marked, Overdue or Forfeit. Past Clean you hear it: a far bell when Marked, chains when Overdue, footsteps when Forfeit, when animals start running from you too. A Tally Stick tells you which.
emi.atouchofwickedness.info.atonement: Good deeds take Wickedness away: breeding animals, taming one, feeding a hurt pet, curing a zombie villager, or throwing a villager food, a few times a day.
emi.atouchofwickedness.info.bailiff: Push too far and the Bailiff comes for your stuff, not your life. It robs a chest you opened nearby, or hits you to take a stack, never what you're holding, or grabs something worth taking off the ground. The pricier a stack, the likelier it goes. At night it sleeps first. On Peaceful it still steals, unless you block it with a shield. If it leaves empty-handed, you still owe, and it comes back. Only one comes every %s minutes.
emi.atouchofwickedness.info.seal: Dropped by a dead Bailiff. Crafts the Tally Stick and the Strongbox, and repairs the Tally Stick in an anvil.
emi.atouchofwickedness.info.tally_stick: Use it to see roughly how wicked you are. Good for %s uses, repaired with a Seal in an anvil.
emi.atouchofwickedness.info.strongbox: A chest the Bailiff can't rob.
emi.atouchofwickedness.info.bailiffs_bag: Sometimes dropped by a dead Bailiff. A bundle that holds as much as %s.
